fixtures.name: linear_torsion_spring
assumptions: linear, lossless, zero-preload spring
positive theta and omega increase spring displacement
actuator input torque balances spring restoring torque
fixtures.claim_ceiling: analytic spring semantics only; no real spring hysteresis, fatigue, creep, damping or passivity qualification

fixtures.name: antagonistic_tendon_pair
assumptions: equal, constant moment arms
two equal linear tendon stiffnesses
small angular perturbation around the declared configuration
no pulley friction, tendon routing hysteresis or slack
fixtures.claim_ceiling: ideal tendon pair statics; does not establish tendon lifetime, force-sensing accuracy or achievable variable-stiffness bandwidth

fixtures.name: sensorized_tendon_extension
assumptions: linear axial elasticity
quasistatic loading
zero initial extension and no preload
fixtures.claim_ceiling: extension-to-tension equation only; sensor calibration, hysteresis, creep and temperature compensation are unqualified

fixtures.name: gear_reflected_rotor_inertia
assumptions: ideal rigid lossless gear
N = motor angular speed / output angular speed
no gearbox inertia, backlash, compliance, friction or motor/drive losses
fixtures.claim_ceiling: ideal gear kinematics and reflected inertia; not an actuator efficiency or torque-density result

fixtures.name: signed_joint_mechanical_work
assumptions: constant torque and angular velocity over the interval
positive power means mechanical energy enters the joint output port
fixtures.claim_ceiling: mechanical port work only; negative work is not evidence of electrical regeneration

fixtures.name: coupled_two_axis_stiffness_matrix
assumptions: linear symmetric stiffness matrix
small displacement about one declared operating configuration
no stiffness modulation during the sample
fixtures.claim_ceiling: local linear stiffness semantics; no proof of full-workspace stability, modulation passivity or actual parallel-mechanism kinematics

fixtures.name: unilateral_tendon_slack_and_engagement
assumptions: unilateral tension-only tendon
linear axial stiffness after slack is taken up
no friction, hysteresis, creep, pretension or routing compliance
fixtures.claim_ceiling: ideal slack and engagement semantics; not a tendon fatigue, routing or sensor-calibration model

fixtures.name: cubic_strain_stiffening_joint_spring
assumptions: conservative odd-symmetric cubic spring law
positive k1 and non-negative k3
no rate dependence, hysteresis, fatigue or preload
fixtures.claim_ceiling: nonlinear conservative restoring law only; no evidence that any material follows this law over a useful load/temperature/lifetime envelope

fixtures.name: transmission_backlash_deadband
assumptions: symmetric backlash deadband
linear torsional stiffness after tooth/cable engagement
no impact dynamics, tooth compliance hysteresis or friction
fixtures.claim_ceiling: quasistatic deadband semantics; no dynamic impact or gear life qualification

fixtures.name: coulomb_viscous_friction_dissipation
assumptions: Coulomb plus viscous kinetic friction away from zero speed
at zero speed static friction is set-valued and balances applied torque up to declared capacity
no temperature or direction-dependent friction
fixtures.claim_ceiling: ideal friction sign and dissipation; zero-speed static friction is not modeled by sign(0)=0 and requires a set-valued solver rule

fixtures.name: corrected_compliance_deflection_torque_uncertainty

equations.first_order_standard_uncertainty_nm: sqrt((delta_theta * sigma_k)^2 + (k * sigma_delta_theta)^2) assuming independent inputs

assumptions: small elastic deflection in a calibrated compliant transmission
encoder deflection is transmission-error-compensated
stiffness and deflection uncertainties are independent and standard deviations
no hysteresis, temperature drift, preload uncertainty or cross-axis coupling
fixtures.claim_ceiling: first-order estimator uncertainty under stated assumptions; not proof that embedded sensing can replace an external torque transducer

fixtures.name: dual_encoder_deflection_and_torque_uncertainty

equations.torque_variance_nm2: (corrected_deflection * sigma_stiffness)^2 + k^2 * deflection_variance, assuming independent inputs

assumptions: motor and output encoder angles are expressed in compatible frames and gear direction conventions
gear ratio is exact for this oracle
zero offset is calibrated and its stated uncertainty is independent
encoder and stiffness standard uncertainties are independent
linear elastic transmission torque equals stiffness times corrected differential deflection
no hysteresis, backlash, temperature drift, preload uncertainty or cross-axis coupling
fixtures.claim_ceiling: analytic dual-encoder torque and first-order uncertainty oracle only; not validation of actual encoder hardware or a safety-rated torque sensor

validation_rules: Reject non-positive stiffness, inertia and gear-ratio parameters.
Reject incompatible dimensions and unit declarations.
Do not infer measured torque from tendon strain without a calibrated, configuration-specific sensor model.
Do not infer battery regeneration from negative mechanical work.
Do not treat a stored angle limit as an enforced runtime constraint.
Report analytic fixture PASS separately from simulator, HIL and physical evidence.
